title: आईने के सामने लिया फैसला
style: Cinematic, cartoon-realistic avatar, detailed, natural pose, realistic lighting, soft shadows

MAIN.name: Meera
MAIN.description: 29-year-old Indian girl, medium-brown skin, long black hair tied in a simple braid, dark brown eyes, slim build, wearing a pale-yellow cotton kurta and navy-blue salwar, small silver earrings.

SUPPORT.name: Sarla
SUPPORT.description: 45-year-old Indian woman, warm brown skin, black hair with a few gray strands tied in a bun, medium build, dark brown eyes, wearing a simple maroon sari and thin gold earrings.

scenes.text: मीरा एक छोटे शहर के साधारण घर में रहती थी। उसे चित्र बनाना बहुत पसंद था, लेकिन वह अपने बनाए चित्र किसी को दिखाने से डरती थी।

sub_image_prompts.scene_prompt: Meera is sitting on a wooden chair inside a simple Indian home, quietly drawing in a sketchbook near a window, looking thoughtful and slightly emotional.
Meera quietly closes her sketchbook and places it inside a wooden drawer, looking nervous and hesitant, with the same home interior visible around her.

scenes.text: अगले दिन सरला ने मीरा से पूछा कि वह अपने चित्र दूसरों को क्यों नहीं दिखाती।

sub_image_prompts.text: सरला मीरा से बात करती हुई
sub_image_prompts.scene_prompt: Meera is sitting with Sarla in the same simple Indian home, listening carefully as Sarla speaks to her with a warm encouraging expression.
Meera stands near the window holding her sketchbook, looking calmer and more confident after speaking with Sarla.

ending_message: कभी-कभी सबसे बड़ा कदम दुनिया के सामने नहीं, बल्कि अपने डर के सामने उठाना पड़ता है।
cta: ऐसी प्रेरणादायक कहानियों के लिए हमें फॉलो करें।
